items.title: Charles Davis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 23, 1997
items.q: Well I first started out playing with Sun Ra around band-wise I think, as far as an established band, in the 50s.

ctx.x: I haven’t figured it out either. Do you recall what you consider your first real professional gig that lasted a length of time? Mid-50s perhaps?
Yeah it was in the ‘50s. Well I first started out playing with Sun Ra around band-wise I think, as far as an established band, in the 50s.

When people hear the words Sun Ra, if they know at all who he is, I think most of us probably think of the kind of outlandish trappings that went along with all the things he did, but when you started with him in the mid-50s, what kind of music was he doing then?
